Nautilus: Nautilus is a nautilus who likes water skiing and having fun with Octi and Squidy
Octi: Octi is one of Nautilus' cousins. He likes his hat and doesn't like his sibling, Squirt, and Inky, or their pet crab, Clippy.
Squidy: Squidy is one of Nautilus' cousins. He is very protective of Octi, though, since he is so jumpy, Octi and Nautilus end up protecting him.
Babylus: Babylus is Nautilus' little brother. He likes to play pranks on the big kids with Inky and Squirt. He also likes Pufflet and Projecter doggy a lot.
Projecter Doggy: Projecter doggy is Nautilus' "dog", as Octi once said. He has a singular eye that doubles as a projecter. Apart from that he is a normal metal box with legs, ears, and a tail, that behaves like a dog. He likes to eat batteries, electrobones, and pepperoni slices.
Squirt: Squirt is a small orange octopus with a small orange hat. He can change colors and blend in to the enviroment. He is Octi's little brother. Squirt likes to play pranks on the big kids with Inky and Babylus.
Inky: Inky is a small pink octopus with a small pink bow. She can squirt ink out of her tentacles and fly if someone twists her bow(Squirt, usaully). She is Octi's little sister. Inky likes to play pranks on the big kids with Squirt and Babylus.
Pufflet: Pufflet is a baby pufferfish. He is very cuddly and everybody likes him. He tries to play pranks on the big kids but mostly ends up falling into a cookie jar. He is Puffy's brother. Pufflet wants to be a painter.
Puffy: Puffy is a yellow pufferfish. He is not related to nautilus in any way but hangs out with him a lot, as well as Squidy and Octi. Puffy likes to comment on anything and everything, which can get annoying.
Clippy: Clippy is a small crab who Squirt and Inky keep as a pet. He likes to clip Octi. Quote from Octi: "YEOOOOOOOOUUUUUUCHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!"
Hermy: Hermy is a hermit crab who lives with Puffy. He likes "snaks".
Horseshoecrabby: Horseshoecrabby is a horseshoe crab. He likes scissors and cutting thinks like string and wires. He goes on adventures with Nautilus, Octi, and Squidy sometimes.
Bob The Triangle: Bob is a blue triangle with a green backpack. His best friend is Cuboid
Cuboid: Cuboid is a collection of floating blue bricks. He is strong but not very smart. He eats onions, trash, metal, and radioactive waste.
